text:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  release_info:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      release: ${{ steps.release.outputs.release }}
      name: ${{ steps.release.outputs.name }}
      version: ${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
      tag: ${{ steps.release.outputs.tag }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - name: Check release version
        id: release
        run: node scripts/release.ts
        env:
          RELEASE_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      # One failing React version should not cancel the other.
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        react: [18, 19]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - if: matrix.react != 19
        run: npm install --no-save react@${{ matrix.react }} react-dom@${{ matrix.react }} @types/react@${{ matrix.react }} @types/react-dom@${{ matrix.react }}
      # Formatting, lint and type checks first, so they fail before the browser download.
      - run: npm run check
      # The tests run in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit. Browsers are cached per Playwright version.
      - id: playwright
        run: echo "version=$(node -p "require('playwright/package.json').version")" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - id: playwright-cache
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
          key: playwright-${{ runner.os }}-${{ steps.playwright.outputs.version }}
      - if: steps.playwright-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium firefox webkit
      - if: steps.playwright-cache.outputs.cache-hit == 'true'
        run: npx playwright install-deps chromium firefox webkit
      - run: npm test
      - if: matrix.react == 19
        run: npm run build
      - if: matrix.react == 19
        run: npm run pack
      # useanimations.com, built from the same icon set and component.
      - if: matrix.react == 19
        run: npm run website:build
      - name: Upload verified npm package
        if: matrix.react == 19
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: npm-package
          path: .release/*.tgz
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 7

  website:
    # useanimations.com is deployed from main after the tests pass.
    needs: test
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: website
      url: https://useanimations.com
    concurrency:
      group: website-deploy
      cancel-in-progress: false
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          # Full history: the sitemap's lastmod dates come from Git (website/src/lib/git.ts).
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run website:build
        env:
          SITE_URL: https://useanimations.com
      - name: Deploy to Netlify
        run: npx --yes netlify-cli@27 deploy --prod --no-build --dir website/dist --site "$NETLIFY_SITE_ID" --message "$GITHUB_SHA"
        env:
          NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          NETLIFY_SITE_ID: ${{ vars.NETLIFY_SITE_ID }}

  preview:
    # Every PR from this repository gets its own preview at pr-<number>--<site>.netlify.app.
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # The link shows up in the PR as "View deployment".
    environment:
      name: preview
      url: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.url }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    concurrency:
      group: website-preview-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          # Full history: the sitemap's lastmod dates come from Git (website/src/lib/git.ts).
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      # Previews build every language, including those not live yet (website/src/i18n/locales.ts).
      - run: npm run website:build
        env:
          I18N_PREVIEW: '1'
      # Keep previews out of search engines.
      - run: |
          printf '\n/*\n  X-Robots-Tag: noindex\n' >> website/dist/_headers
      - name: Deploy preview to Netlify
        id: deploy
        run: |
          url=$(npx --yes netlify-cli@27 deploy --no-build --dir website/dist --site "$NETLIFY_SITE_ID" --alias "pr-$PR" --message "PR #$PR $GITHUB_SHA" --json | jq -r '.deploy_url')
          echo "url=$url" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        env:
          PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          NETLIFY_SITE_ID: ${{ vars.NETLIFY_SITE_ID }}
      # One comment per PR, updated on every push.
      - name: Comment preview URL
        run: |
          gh pr comment "$PR" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --edit-last --create-if-none --body "### 🔎 Website preview
          **$URL**

          Updated for commit $SHA."
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          URL: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.url }}
          SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

  publish:
    needs: [release_info, test]
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && needs.release_info.outputs.release == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: npm
      url: https://www.npmjs.com/package/${{ needs.release_info.outputs.name }}/v/${{ needs.release_info.outputs.version }}
    concurrency:
      group: npm-publish
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      # Node 24 ships npm 11, which supports Trusted Publishing.
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
          package-manager-cache: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: npm-package
          path: package
      - name: Publish verified package to npm
        run: |
          packages=(package/*.tgz)
          if [ "${#packages[@]}" -ne 1 ] || [ ! -f "${packages[0]}" ]; then
            echo 'Expected exactly one verified npm package.' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if curl -fsSo /dev/null "https://registry.npmjs.org/$NAME/$VERSION"; then
            echo "$NAME@$VERSION is already published; skipping."
            exit 0
          fi
          npm publish "./${packages[0]}" --access public --tag "$NPM_TAG" --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/
        env:
          NAME: ${{ needs.release_info.outputs.name }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.release_info.outputs.version }}
          NPM_TAG: ${{ needs.release_info.outputs.tag }}

  github_release:
    needs: [release_info, publish]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: npm-package
          path: package
      - name: Tag and create GitHub release
        run: |
          if gh release view "$GIT_TAG" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "GitHub release $GIT_TAG already exists; skipping."
            exit 0
          fi
          if [ "$NPM_TAG" = latest ]; then
            flags=(--latest)
          else
            flags=(--prerelease --latest=false)
          fi
          gh release create "$GIT_TAG" package/*.tgz --target "$GITHUB_SHA" --title "$GIT_TAG" --generate-notes "${flags[@]}"
        env:
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GIT_TAG: v${{ needs.release_info.outputs.version }}
          NPM_TAG: ${{ needs.release_info.outputs.tag }}
